title: Rassimov
summary: Rassimov was the leader of the Blood Spiral and was a terrifyingly powerful and cunning Seeker. For years, he worked undercover as the Professor's lackey in order to weaken the Organization from the inside, all the while following the orders of the Betrayer in their plan to call back the Nullifiers to Earth and wipe out all life.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
A ruthless Seeker with a hidden agenda, Rassimov joined the Organization and quickly established himself as the Professor's perfect operative, with over a hundred missions and no failures. [The Unseen Guide] This was, however, all part of a much bigger plans to prevent the Professor from becoming too powerful and eventually causing his downfall. [Divide and Conquer]

Image caption: Rassimov uses his devastating Darkvoid power to destroy Cavalier

He had his first direct encounter with the Huntik team at the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot where he tailed Dante Vale and Lok Lambert, helping them survive several of the deadly tests so that they would lead him to Sir Lancelot's Titan Cavalier. As him and his Suits attacked, he easily defeated Lok and claimed the Amulet. However, the noble Titan refused to bond with him, so Rassimov callously destroyed the Titan using his devastating Darkvoid power, to the horror of the Huntik team. [Memory Lane]

Based on his intense hatred for the Casterwills, the Foundation suspected him to be connected to the Nullifiers whom Casterwill defeated. He was extremely physically skilled and possessed a command of dark spells and Titans, making him a match for Dante Vale's whole team. [The Unseen Guide] After following the team to Atlantis, Rassimov fought with an enraged Lok who blamed the Organization for causing him to lose his father, believing him to be dead. Using all his strength, Lok managed to defeat Rassimov, forcing him and his men to retreat. [Coming of Age]

After appearing to fall into one of his own traps, he gave Dante Vale the Amulet of Archwarder so that the team could use it to defeat the Professor. He then met up with his real group, the Blood Spiral, and plotted the end of the world and the Casterwill family, with Shauna and Wind. [The Divine Comedy]

Image caption: Rassimov returns

After the Professor´s defeat, Rassimov made his return in Klaus' bookshop, revealing himself as the leader of the Blood Spirals. He attempted to eliminate Dante but was stopped when the latter powerbonded with Caliban. He and his forces then left with the Amulet of Void but not before completely destroying the lab. [The Blood Spiral]

Rassimov began searching for new members for the Brotherhood and sent his minions to hunt the Casterwill family, while he talked with the Betrayer on his throne. He ordained several of Tantras' orphan recruits including the brothers Den and Harrison Fears with the tattoo of Blood Spiral. [Den vs Harrison] [Zhalia's Mission] [Sophie on Trial]

Rassimov traveled to the Tomb of Tutankhamun in Egypt with Harrison Fears to recover the Necklace of Tutankhamun. He was then ambushed and arrested by the Huntik Foundation his Amulets all unbonded and locked away by Dante and his Sorrowbond power. However he was rescued by Harrison and, revealing the true extent of his power, summoned the Legendary Titan of War, Legion. Defeating the Huntik team, and destroying the Amulets of Lindorm and Solwing, Rassimov escaped with the Necklace. [Rassimov's Secret] The team took time to recover from this defeat, staying at the Lambert house in County Kerry, Ireland. [Back Home]

Image caption: Rassimov and Void attempt to control the Red Comet

On the longest night of the year, Rassimov prepared the ritual to activate the Spiral Mark by summoning the Nullifier scout, Void. [Words from Eathon] When Dante and his team arrived, Rassimov announced he would deal with them personally, summoning Legion. However he was defeated by Dante and Legion destroyed by Lok and the Willblade. Following the revelation that the Red Comet had changed course to hit the spot of the Spiral Mark, Rassimov revealed his own scheme to double cross the Betrayer and the other Spirals, planning to control the Nullifiers with the Necklace of Tutankhamun. However, his plan failed when the Necklace was disintegrated and he died in the subsequent collision with the Comet. [The Spiral Mark]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E20 Rassimov Gold Scarabese 1.png|thumb|200px]]
From the beginning, Rassimov appeared to be a very loyal follower of the Professor. In [[the Organization]], he was known for completing all of his missions successfully, the Professor even called him the perfect operative, stating that he had successfully completed over a hundred missions without failure. {{source|The Unseen Guide}} His cold personality and cruel demeanor made Rassimov a force to be feared. He later revealed that his loyalty was merely a facade and that he was actually a member of the [[Blood Spiral Brotherhood]]. {{source|The Blood Spiral}} It was partly due to his actions that the Professor lost in battle, giving Dante the [[Amulet]] of [[Archwarder]]. {{source|The Divine Comedy}} But even so, Rassimov thought of obtaining power only for himself, and he betrayed the Brotherhood he has claimed to lead, ultimately leading to his own downfall. {{source|The Spiral Mark}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E47_Rassimov_Thornment_Darkfog.png|thumb|200px|Rassimov and [[Thornment]]]]
A [[Seeker]] of devastating power, Rassimov possessed a range of dark abilities that were unsettling just to watch. The spells he generally favored were based on obliteration and consigning things to nothingness, along with other powerful Blood Spiral spells, his strongest being the deadly [[Darkvoid]]. {{source|Memory Lane}}. A master at hand to hand combat, he was able to overpower Dante in battle. {{source|Ladies' Choice}} Rassimov also possessed a vast arsenal of ancient Egyptian [[Titans]], most notably the sinister [[Thornment]] and majestic [[Kopesh]]. {{source|Coming of Age}} As a last resort, he had the devastating [[Legendary Titan]] of War, [[Legion]], hidden within his body, given to him by [[the Betrayer]] himself. {{source|Rassimov's Secret}}

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Ammit Heart-Eater — TV Series — taken — A ferocious crocodile treated by Rassimov as a pet; unbonded by Dante's Sorrowbond power and locked away by the Huntik Foundation.

Anubian — TV Series — taken — An ancient Egyptian power formed by the five Scarabese; unbonded by Dante's Sorrowbond power and locked away.

Archwarder — TV Series — given away — Given by the Professor, Rassimov betrayed his master by giving it to Dante to defeat the Professor for him; A year later he callously destroyed it using Darkvoid.

Black Scarabese x4 — TV Series — taken — Four Black Scarabese used simultaneously as a spy network, and which formed the limbs of Anubian; all four had their bonds permanently broken by Dante's Sorrowbond spell and were locked away.

Dark Pharaoh — TV Series — given away — An ancient Blood Spiral Titan, Rassimov gave it to Suit 040 to fight the Huntik Foundation.

Gold Scarabese — TV Series — taken — Worn as an eyepiece for spying and the head of Anubian; Dante unbonded it using Sorrowbond and ordered it be contained separately to prevent Anubian being formed.

Kopesh — TV Series — taken — One of Rassimov's favored combat Titans; unbonded by Dante using Sorrowbond and locked away.

Legion — TV Series — destroyed — The Legendary Titan of War, given by the Betrayer and hidden within his body as his secret weapon; Destroyed after Lok shattered its Amulet with the Willblade, freeing the spirits of all the Titans it absorbed.

Sekhmet — TV Series — taken — The Egyptian cat goddess; unbonded by Dante and locked away.

Thornment — TV Series — taken — Rassimov's Signature Titan used for many missions while he was in the Organization; unbonded by Dante and locked away.

Void — TV Series — unknown — The mysterious scout of the Nullifiers; it was last seen teleporting with Rassimov into space and colliding with the Red Comet; it is unknown if it survived.
